subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book 'Modi Government: New Surge of Communalism'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitaram Yechury**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book **Modi Government: New Surge of Communalism** is written by **Sitaram Yechury.**
 
• This book is a collection of some of the writings by **Sitaram Yechury on communalism and the threat it poses to the secular democratic foundations of India.**
 
• It is being published in** response to a request from many quarters** that the Modi Ministry assume control of the **Central Government for the first time on the basis of a single-party majority for the BJP in the LOK SABHA**.
 
• Other books by Sitaram Yechury:
 
 
• What is This Hindu Rashtra?
 
• Pseudo Hinduism Exposed: Saffron Brigade's Myths and Reality
 
• Caste and Class in Indian Politics Today
 
• Ghrina Ki Rajniti
